promptText: Which hotel brands are commonly considered by owners for design-forward or distinctive-character lifestyle positioning in the Caribbean and Latin America?

payload.rawResponseText:
As of **September 2026**, there is no single published “owner shortlist,” but the following brands most often form the competitive set for design-forward, locally distinctive hotels in the Caribbean and Latin America.

## Core collection and soft-brand options

These generally offer owners the greatest freedom to preserve an existing name, architecture and local story.

| Hotel group | Brands commonly considered | Typical positioning |
|---|---|---|
| **Marriott International** | **Autograph Collection**, **Tribute Portfolio**, **The Luxury Collection**, **Design Hotels** | Upper-upscale through luxury independent hotels; Autograph is broadly applicable, Tribute is often more social and approachable, Luxury Collection suits iconic luxury assets, and Design Hotels favors conceptually strong design. Marriott has active Autograph and Tribute development throughout CALA. ([help.marriott.com](https://help.marriott.com/s/article/Article-24483?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hilton** | **Curio Collection**, **Tapestry Collection**, **LXR Hotels & Resorts** | Curio for upper-upscale/luxury character hotels; Tapestry for more accessible upscale conversions; LXR for individually branded luxury resorts. Curio and Tapestry have expanded materially in CALA, including Mexico, Brazil, Puerto Rico, Bonaire and the Dominican Republic. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hilton-wraps-2024-with-record-portfolio-and-pipeline-growth-in-the-caribbean-and-latin-america?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hyatt** | **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**, **JdV by Hyatt**, **Destination by Hyatt** | Unbound for story-rich luxury or upper-upscale properties; JdV for neighborhood-oriented lifestyle hotels; Destination for distinctive resorts. Unbound is expanding in Argentina and the Dominican Republic, among other Americas markets. ([newsroom.hyatt.com](https://newsroom.hyatt.com/may-5-2025-andazmiamiopening?utm_source=openai)) |
| **IHG** | **Vignette Collection** | Flexible luxury/lifestyle collection for independently minded hotels. Its regional rollout includes SOUMA Hotel Lima, which opened in March 2025. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases/2025/ihg-hotels-and-resorts-strengthens-position-across-mexico-latin-america-and-the-caribbean?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Accor** | **MGallery Collection**, **Handwritten Collection**, **Emblems Collection** | MGallery for upper-upscale boutique hotels, Handwritten for conversion-friendly character properties, and Emblems for luxury independents. Accor explicitly positions these collection brands around preserving owner identity and authenticity. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/hotel-development?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Wyndham** | **Registry Collection Hotels**, **Trademark Collection by Wyndham** | Registry for independent luxury resorts and Trademark for upper-midscale/upscale conversions where independence and flexible standards are priorities. ([development.wyndhamhotels.com](https://development.wyndhamhotels.com/?utm_source=openai)) |

## More prescribed lifestyle brands

These can produce a stronger consumer identity but normally require greater adherence to brand design, programming, F&B and service concepts.

- **Marriott:** **W Hotels**, **EDITION**, **Moxy**, **Aloft**, and sometimes **AC Hotels** or **Le Méridien**. W and EDITION occupy the luxury-lifestyle end; Moxy and Aloft address more accessible, social lifestyle positioning. ([help.marriott.com](https://help.marriott.com/s/article/Article-24483?utm_source=openai))
- **Hilton:** **Canopy by Hilton**, **Motto by Hilton**, and **Tempo by Hilton**. Canopy is usually the most directly relevant for locally influenced, full-service lifestyle hotels, while Motto targets compact urban properties. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hilton-set-to-double-lifestyle-portfolio-to-700-hotels-within-next-four-years?utm_source=openai))
- **Hyatt:** **Andaz**, **Thompson Hotels**, **The Standard**, **Dream Hotels**, **Alila**, and **Bunkhouse Hotels**. Hyatt now groups these among its principal lifestyle offerings; the region has or is receiving Andaz, Thompson, Standard, Dream and Alila projects. ([newsroom.hyatt.com](https://newsroom.hyatt.com/news-releases?item=124592&utm_source=openai))
- **IHG:** **Kimpton Hotels & Restaurants** and **Hotel Indigo**. Kimpton usually competes at the upper-upscale/luxury boutique level; Indigo is more neighborhood-story-driven and conversion compatible. Both are part of IHG’s active Mexico, Latin America and Caribbean luxury-and-lifestyle strategy. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases/2025/ihg-hotels-and-resorts-strengthens-position-across-mexico-latin-america-and-the-caribbean?utm_source=openai))
- **Accor/Ennismore:** **SLS**, **Mondrian**, **SO/**, **Hyde**, **Delano**, **Mama Shelter**, **25hours**, **TRIBE**, and **Our Habitas**. These are particularly relevant where restaurants, nightlife, wellness and local-community activation are central to the business model. Accor also markets SLS, SO/, Mondrian and Hyde for luxury all-inclusive applications. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/gaurav-bhushan?utm_source=openai))
- **Hyatt Inclusive Collection:** **Breathless**, **Impression by Secrets** and **Zoëtry** can enter the conversation when the concept is an experiential or design-led all-inclusive resort rather than a conventional boutique hotel. ([newsroom.hyatt.com](https://newsroom.hyatt.com/may-5-2025-andazmiamiopening?utm_source=openai))

## Practical first-round shortlist

For many owners, the most useful initial comparison is:

1. **Autograph Collection**
2. **Tribute Portfolio**
3. **Curio Collection**
4. **Tapestry Collection**
5. **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**
6. **Vignette Collection**
7. **Kimpton**
8. **Hotel Indigo**
9. **MGallery**
10. **An appropriate Ennismore brand**
11. **Registry Collection**
12. **An independent affiliation such as Design Hotels, Preferred Hotels & Resorts, Small Luxury Hotels of the World or Leading Hotels of the World**

The correct shortlist depends heavily on **ADR target, resort versus urban setting, new-build versus conversion, all-inclusive format, room count, branded residences, owner control over F&B, loyalty contribution and available territorial rights**. Collection brands are normally the starting point when preserving character is paramount; hard lifestyle brands become more compelling when the owner wants a recognizable concept and is willing to adopt a more prescribed operating model.
